title: Caste, COVID vaccine, bank accounts, voter/aadhaar: The big changes in census 2027
content:
For the first time since Independence, India’s Census will record the caste of all respondents, making Census 2027 one of the most significant demographic exercises in the country’s history.

The new questionnaire expands from 29 categories in Census 2011 to 40 questions and includes information on caste, digital literacy, Aadhaar, mobile numbers, bank accounts, voter IDs, passports and more.

But why is the caste question creating political debate? How will the open-column system work? And what lessons has the government drawn from the 2011 Socio-Economic and Caste Census?

In this explainer, we break down the biggest changes in Census 2027, why they matter, and what they could mean for policymaking, welfare schemes and representation in India.

title: Modi becomes second PM after Nehru to deliver 13 consecutive I-Day speeches
content: prime minister has addressed the nation every Independence Day since taking office in 2014 . his latest address came on india's 80th Independence Day . surpassed former prime minister Indira Gandhi who delivered 11 consecutive Independence Day speeches between 1966 and 1976 .

title: 80th Independence Day: PM Modi’s 75-minute speech shortest in four years
content: the 2026 address was significantly shorter than his 103-minute speech last year . in 2017, he spoke for 56 minutes and his first Independence Day address in 2014 lasted 65 minutes . the speech was the fourth shortest of his 13 consecutive appearances at the historic ramparts .

title: 'Swiftly ensure 33% reservation for women': PM Modi to political parties on I-Day
content: prime minister urged political parties to facilitate implementation of the proposed 33% reservation for women in the Lok Sabha and state legislative assemblies . he made the call while addressing the nation from the iconic Red Fort in Delhi on the 80th Independence Day .

title: Dimagi Naxals, Sapta Dhara and Viksit Bharat: Top 5 highlights from PM Modi’s speech
content: the framework, called 'Shakti Ki Saptadhara', covers manufacturing, agriculture and food processing, technology and innovation, Gati Shakti, defence production, the green and blue economy, and India's soft power . he also said India has moved from being counted among the 'Fragile Five' economies to becoming the world's fastest-growing major economy over the past 12 years .

title: 'Many forces don't want India to become Vishwaguru’: RSS chief Bhagwat
content: Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) Mohan Bhagwat called on people tostrengthen India's independence by making the country happy, prosperous, and secure . the chief said that if the freedom struggle is traced to 1857, the ancestors made sacrifices for nearly 90 years to secure independence .

title: What’s in it for Gen Z in PM Modi’s speech - AI skills, free coaching, sports & jobs
content: prime minister said one crore youth would be trained in artificial intelligence-related skills . the announcement came as he described AI, quantum technology, robotics and robotics . he linked the Viksit Bharat goal to the country's young population .

title: Indonesia earthquake: 20 killed, buildings collapse as aftershocks rattle region
content: a powerful magnitude 7.7 earthquake struck off flories island early Saturday . the main tremor struck around 6 am local time, 68 kilometres northwest of Ende . it was followed by several aftershocks, with strong shaking reported across parts of Flores .

title: 'Hathiyari Naxals gone but need to be wary of dimagi Naxals': PM Modi
content: armed Naxalism has been curbed, but 'intellectual Naxals' still lurking . he warns that people with maoist thinking are still present in different parts of the country . "we need to identify these dimagi naxal, isolate them," he says .

title: ‘Some people gain joy in keeping nation terrified’: PM on Covid, West Asia crisis
content: prime minister says the country emerged from the pandemic only to confront a tense global environment . he also accused some people of deliberately creating anxiety by spreading rumours about shortages of essential supplies . the country has faced a series of crises over the past 10-12 years, including COVID-19 and wars in Ukraine and West Asia .

title: PM Modi unveils 'Sapta Dhara' for 'Viksit Bharat': What is his seven-point roadmap
content: "sapta Dhara" is a seven-point reform framework that will accelerate India's march towards its goal of Viksit Bharat by 2047 . the country's youth power will be utilised in nation-building, PM Modi says .
